judgeAgent.diagramCaption: Judge Agent Workflow: The candidate bidding_policy.py is received by the Judge Agent, which executes in-memory simulation via evaluate_policy() and formulates an objective Policy Evaluation (yield score, diagnostics, and algorithmic recommendations).

hints.tool: In judge_agent.py above, add evaluate_policy to the tools list:
hints.prompt: In judge_agent.py above, update instruction="" in judge_agent to:

load.title: 1. Load Policy from Disk
load.description: Compiles the candidate Python script and verifies the compute_bid(context) function.

simulate.title: 2. Run the Simulation
simulate.description: Simulates 48 half-hour auction intervals across a 24-hour campaign flight under diurnal clearing prices and market volatility.

metrics.title: 3. Return Metrics
metrics.description: Packages impressions, spend, budget utilization, eCPM, and the overall yield score for the Judge.

persona.title: Adversarial Judge Persona
persona.description: Directs Gemini to evaluate microeconomic viability with zero author confirmation bias, isolating economic traps that the Generator misses.

telemetry.title: Multi-Dimensional Telemetry Inspection
telemetry.description: Audits budget utilization, pacing survival across the 24-hour campaign flight, and primetime yield under dynamic market physics.

recommendations.title: Actionable Mathematical Recommendations
recommendations.description: Compels the Judge to provide explicit algorithmic pacing formulas (e.g., dynamic pacing multipliers) rather than vague subjective feedback.

judgeAgent.nextLockedTitle: Equip evaluate_policy in the tools array above to unlock
judgeAgent.equipPrompt: Equip the judge prompt specification by setting instruction=PROMPT_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8") in judge_agent above.
judgeAgent.lockedBody: Register evaluate_policy in tools=[...] and bind the judge prompt in instruction=... above to unlock live policy evaluation.
